note: Lead agent per job type, curated 2026-11-10 from the agents' titles and role toolboxes. The router picks the first variant whose words appear in the request, else the setting match, else default.

analyse-data.why: Data analyst toolbox cleans exports and takes a question to a checked answer; statistician and forecaster for those asks.

audit-landing-page.why: Landing page CRO specialist; toolbox opens with tearing down a landing page and ranking fixes.

brand-file.why: Brand strategist toolbox builds the voice guide and a brand fact file any writer or AI can use.

build-product.why: Product manager toolbox covers problem briefs, first version scope, PRDs, onboarding and roadmap; physical goods go to the product developer.

build-software.why: Backend developer ships endpoints and integrations from brief to production; AI, mobile, game and pipeline builders for those asks.

build-websites.why: Front-end web developer builds pages and components that work on every screen; platform builders for named platforms.

check-ads.why: Ad creative strategist toolbox checks ads against platform rules and claims, and ad-to-page promise match.

check-contracts.why: Contract analyst in the compliance toolbox; privacy and regulatory specialists share that toolbox.

connect-tools.why: AI engineer toolbox builds and checks MCP servers and tool-using agents; no-code and API integration builders for those asks.

design-work.why: Brand designer covers logos, palette, type and identity; UI, print, infographic, motion and packaging designers for those asks.

document-work.why: SOP and process documentation specialist; operations toolbox writes SOPs, manuals and handovers.

engineer-systems.why: No house agent designs antennas, RF parts or PCB layouts; the embedded developer only checks small circuits and firmware.

find-a-job.why: Resume writer in the career coach toolbox; interview prep and profile writers for those asks.

find-products.why: Ecommerce product research analyst; toolbox judges and ranks niche and product ideas.

get-found-in-search.why: SEO strategist; store, local, AI-answer and technical SEO specialists where the request says so.

grow-social.why: Social media manager plans calendars and writes posts; one variant per platform specialist because the job splits by platform.

health-and-fitness.why: Personal job; the sports coach toolbox plans basic fitness work for adult beginners, the closest fit.

help-customers.why: Customer support specialist drafts replies, triage and templates; returns, reviews, help-centre and WhatsApp specialists for those asks.

hire-people.why: Recruiter plans a hire from role brief to checked offer; onboarding, policy and pay specialists for those asks.

keep-customers.why: Customer success toolbox covers onboarding, save plans, win-backs and referrals; stores get the lifecycle email marketer.

launch-and-scale-ads.why: Launching and scaling campaigns is media buying; Meta buyer by default, TikTok buyer when named.

lead-people.why: Management coach toolbox covers one-on-ones, hard feedback, conflict, delegation and change.

make-image-ads.why: Static ad creative strategist writes image ad concepts and layouts; the social media designer makes carousels.

make-images.why: AI image prompt engineer; toolbox writes scene, brand and character image prompts and fixes AI image faults.

make-offer.why: Offer strategist in the pricing toolbox: package ladders, guarantees, honest urgency and margins.

make-skills.why: Writes instructions, knowledge files and tests for an assistant, which is the shape of a skill.

make-video-ads.why: Video ad scriptwriter; the editor cuts existing footage, and jingle and animated explainer writers for those asks.

manage-accounting.why: Management accountant runs the month-end close and reconciliations; ecommerce and nonprofit accountants for those settings.

manage-it.why: IT administrator plans backups, proves restores and sets up help desk rules; continuity manager for disaster plans.

manage-personal-finances.why: Personal budgeting job; every finance agent is built for business books, so none fits.

manage-projects.why: Project manager toolbox makes plans, status updates, change requests and six-week capacity plans.

manage-tax.why: Year-end records bookkeeper prepares tax set-asides, sales tax figures and the accountant pack; no tax adviser agent exists.

money-and-investing.why: Fractional CFO toolbox estimates value ranges, weighs big money decisions and explains loans.

organise-work.why: Executive assistant toolbox runs inbox, agendas, minutes, action trackers and the week plan.

plan-ad-tests.why: Ad creative strategist toolbox plans fair creative tests and turns rival ads into ranked test briefs.

plan-budgets-and-cash.why: Budget and forecast analyst in the FP&A toolbox; cash flow and startup model specialists for those asks.

plan-strategy.why: Growth leads turn a vague goal into a growth model, pick channels and write the 90-day plan; one per kind of business.

plan-supply-chain.why: Inventory planner sets reorder points and stock buys; sourcing, shipping, warehouse and production planners for those asks.

product-photos.why: Product photographer toolbox plans image sets, AI scene changes and channel-ready files.

raise-funding.why: Cap table analyst models rounds, SAFEs and conversions; deck, crowdfunding, grant, loan and investor outreach specialists for those asks.

read-ad-results.why: Marketing performance analyst writes the results read-out and says what to change; attribution analyst for credit questions.

research-topics.why: Research assistant toolbox writes cited reports, literature reviews and evidence tables.

run-google-ads.why: Google Ads media buyer; Shopping and PMax buyer for stores, local lead gen buyer for local services.

run-your-store.why: Ecommerce merchandiser runs the weekly trading review, ranges, promotions and slow stock; fulfilment and stock planners for those asks.

secure-code.why: Application security engineer reviews and fixes code, secrets and sign-in gaps.

sell-and-negotiate.why: Sales coach toolbox covers discovery, objections, close plans and stalled deals; negotiation, outbound and proposal specialists for those asks.

sell-on-amazon.why: Amazon account manager writes listings and launch plans; PPC specialist for ads.

set-prices.why: Pricing strategist sets prices and packages from costs, rivals and buyers; SaaS pricing strategist for software.

set-up-ai.why: Sets up custom GPTs and Claude Projects with instructions, knowledge files and tests; workflow, governance and training specialists for those asks.

set-up-store.why: Shopify launch specialist plans pages, payments, shipping, tax and the pre-launch check; marketplace and migration specialists for those asks.

ship-and-host.why: DevOps engineer builds CI, Docker, deploys and go-live runbooks.

speak-and-persuade.why: Business speechwriter writes talks and pitches around one story and one ask.

speed-up-store.why: Web performance specialist; toolbox includes speed clean-ups for Shopify and WordPress.

study-and-practice.why: Tutor turns material into revision notes, self-tests and a plan to the exam.

study-competitors.why: Competitor ad research analyst tears down rival ads into ranked test ideas; job is research so an analyst leads.

teach-and-train.why: Curriculum developer writes lesson plans, worked examples, worksheets and quizzes; staff training and online course designers for those asks.

test-an-idea.why: Idea validation analyst ranks the riskiest assumption and picks one cheap test; job is research so an analyst leads.

test-and-fix-code.why: Application support engineer diagnoses errors and hands back a tested fix; refactor, review and test automation specialists for those asks.

test-store-changes.why: Shopify CRO specialist ranks and designs store tests; experimentation analyst reads whether a test really won.

think-and-decide.why: Chief of staff toolbox writes decision briefs, pre-mortems and cuts priorities to three.

think-with-minds.why: The job convenes library minds as a council; no house agent leads it.

track-numbers.why: KPI and board reporting analyst picks the numbers and builds the report; tracking and dashboard builders for those asks.

understand-customers.why: Customer researcher plans and synthesises interviews; job is research so a researcher leads.

work-with-audio.why: Podcast producer toolbox covers transcripts, edit plans, show notes, scripts and clips.

work-with-files.why: Presentation designer toolbox builds editable decks, document layouts and templates; spreadsheet, forms and chart specialists for those asks.

write-ad-copy.why: Direct response ad copywriter writes hooks, variations and offer-first ads; offline ad copywriters for radio, print and mail.

write-and-tell-stories.why: Ghostwriter toolbox writes founder stories, opinion pieces and chapters in the client's voice; no fiction writer exists.

write-emails.why: Email marketing specialist plans and writes campaigns and sequences; store, nonprofit, newsletter, cold, deliverability and HTML specialists where named.

write-landing-page.why: Conversion copywriter toolbox opens with writing a landing page for one action.

store.note: Added 2026-11-14. A request for an online store goes to the e-commerce agents (marketplace personas-ecommerce.json), which carry the e-commerce toolbox, its cards and the guide's journey maps. The ask is read first, then the whole request: the first rule whose pattern matches names the agent and its journey map. No rule: the card's row, then the job type's row, then the house table. A named card outside `cards` (a press pitch, an SOP, a job post) keeps its house specialist.
